deploybot: Tag v3.4.2-rc3 created for commit abc12f4. Canary rollout scheduled — see notes below. Env: production (gradual).

deploybot: Changelog snippet:
```
- runtime: improved KV cache eviction to reduce tail latency
- serving: add fallback to t4-small variant when capacity low
- infra: fix prometheus scrape config for gpu-exporter
```

marisol: thanks — what's the canary plan? duration and regions?

ajay: plan is 10% traffic for 30m in us-west, then 30% for 30m across eu-west, then full if green. staggered by 10m to watch metrics.

lisa-qa: i'll run the prompt-regression suite during the eu-west window and post any diffs. ETA ~40m after start.

ben-sre: adding a temporary hold window for database-migrations consumers: 22:00-23:00 PDT. if anything spikes we roll back to v3.4.1. @marisol please confirm pinning for any dependent services.

marisol: confirmed — platform-api and embed-worker will pin to v3.4.1 until canary clears. i'll unpin when we say go.

olivia: quick note — if the fallback to t4-small triggers we should surface a metric flag so product can throttle non-critical heavy customers. Can we add a labeled metric?

ajay: yes, adding gauge `inference.fallback_t4_triggered` in this tag. it'll show up in the canary dashboard.

deploybot: Release metadata: tag: `v3.4.2-rc3`, commit: `abc12f4`, author: olivia, changelog link: https://git.redwood/release/abc12f4. Canary start: 2024-11-08T05:00:00Z. Rollback label: `rollback/v3.4.1`.

lisa-qa: if i see >1% regression on prompt-suite, i'll comment here with failing prompts and request rollback.

ben-sre: ops playbook reminder: use `./scripts/rollback.sh v3.4.1` and watch the s3 prefix for KV warmup. notify #eng-oncall when executing.

marisol: pinned services updated. please ping if you need the list. good luck + :rocket:

olivia: noted — i'll watch latency p50/p95 and fallback gauge. planning to stay by laptop during canary.

deploybot: Canary started (10% us-west). Logs: `deploybot: canary v3.4.2-rc3 started on fleet-12`.

ajay: rolling out to 30% eu-west in 10m unless issues.

lisa-qa: starting regression run now. will post results.

(End of thread)
